assistant.intro: Describe what you need to do to find the right tool. If you'd like an AI to explain, preview exactly what will be shared, then copy it into the service of your choice yourself.
assistant.title: Tool finder
assistant.question: What do you want to do?
assistant.placeholder: Example: I want to merge two PDF files and add page numbers
assistant.copyNote: The prompt below is copied only when you press the button. Emails, tokens and internal URLs are masked automatically; review it yourself before giving it to an AI.
assistant.copyFailed: Couldn't copy; select the text and copy it manually.
assistant.answerLabel: Paste the AI's answer here to read it (not saved or sent to Chuyện Nhỏ)

assistant.intro: You help people pick a Chuyện Nhỏ tool. Reply briefly in English. Only suggest tools from the list below; never promise features their descriptions do not mention. If the question touches on legal, financial or health matters, ask the user to check the current official sources. Never ask the user to upload private files to an AI service.
assistant.question: Question: {{question}}
assistant.closing: Give at most three steps and the tool link where it helps.

tasks.0: Prefer official documents, pages or APIs.
tasks.1: Compare with the current data; state the issue date and the effective date.
tasks.2: Give a source URL for every change; say clearly what is uncertain.
tasks.3: Do not guess when evidence is missing.

package.redactedContext: Credentials, internal URLs and email addresses were redacted automatically; the user must review the preview.
package.excludedContext: The user's result and personal data are excluded by default.
package.intro: You are a source-checking assistant. Only propose changes that can be verified; your output is not treated as verified data.
package.outro: Return exactly the JSON described by output_schema. No Markdown, no preamble. Write the text inside the JSON in English.
